style.look: dystopian near-future city in cold desaturated teal and ash, film grain, subtle chromatic aberration, thin scan lines, drone telemetry HUD; the house is the only warm, sharp, golden-hour element
rules: keep the house, architecture, materials, furniture and camera paths exactly as in the assets
no people, no faces, no third-party logos, no invented text
transitions: glitch cuts, scan-line wipes from massing to render, whip pans, flash frames, short speed ramps

shots.name: Señal
shots.prompt: Black screen with digital noise, a thin red scan line sweeps across, the tower maquette appears heavily desaturated through interference.
shots.text: 2049. LAS CIUDADES YA NO SE DIBUJAN.

shots.name: La ciudad
shots.prompt: Brutalist towers in toxic haze and drifting dust, cold teal and ash grade, slow push in then speed ramp.

shots.name: Revelación
shots.prompt: Top-down view of the grey 3D massing of Villa Alba; a horizontal scan line with a HUD grid wipes across and turns it into the photoreal golden-hour render; coordinates and plot size tick on screen.

shots.name: Descenso
shots.prompt: Use the clip as is: drone descends from above to eye level in front of the glazed facade; overlay altitude counting down and heading; slow ramp on arrival.

shots.name: Entrada
shots.prompt: Use the clips as is and join them: glide over the pool to the open oak door, then through the hall into the living room; a burst of warm light when crossing the door, the grain and HUD fade out inside.

shots.name: Estancias
shots.prompt: Rapid sequence of the rooms, 0.8 to 1.2 seconds each, slight camera push on every still, whip transitions between them.

shots.name: Ficha
shots.prompt: Aerial three-quarter view of the property, slow orbit feel; data types in like a terminal with flickering digits.

shots.name: La web
shots.pending: grabar la pantalla de la web haciendo scroll por el recorrido (ver KATANA.md, 4.3)
shots.prompt: The screen recording plays on a laptop on a dark desk in a dim concrete room, soft reflection on the screen, product framing, slow dolly.
shots.text: TU PROYECTO, RECORRIDO EN LA WEB

shots.name: El curso
shots.prompt: Strobing before and after: each grey massing view flips to its photoreal render, 0.3 seconds per pair, accelerating.
shots.text: DE PLANO A RENDER · CURSO · 6 MÓDULOS

shots.name: Cierre
shots.prompt: Black background with fine grain; the ZENIT wordmark (letter I in gold) glitches in and then holds perfectly still.
shots.text: ZENIT · RENDERS Y RECORRIDOS CON IA PARA ESTUDIOS
